HOOLHEYAKMOD-INTERSECTION_EVENT.title: Where Past Meets Present
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INTERSECTION_EVENT.pages.IN:
The scrape of metal sounds behind you, followed by that unmistakable male voice.

[fade_in][red]"Ho'olheyak. Traitor. Have you come to this Spire to indulge that laughable curiosity of yours as well?"[/red][/fade_in]

It is the [red]Tin Man[/red]. After your last encounter, you know all too well who would come off worse in another confrontation.
[red]Lose {HpLoss} HP[/red]. [gold]Remove[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] removable cards (or all of them if fewer are available).
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INTERSECTION_EVENT.pages.PO:
[blue]"Why, Mr. Tin Man. What a pleasure. To be perfectly honest, yes, I am here to study this tower."[/blue]

[red]"Then you ought to be more careful. This place is far from safe."[/red]

He shares a few of his supplies with you, and you go your separate ways.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INTERSECTION_EVENT.pages.QU:
[sine][blue]"I am a historian. Is research not simply part of my profession?"[/blue][/sine]

[red]"So you learned nothing from our last encounter. I had hoped you might be a little wiser."[/red]

The moment he finishes speaking, you feel your heart [jitter][red]clenched in a fist[/red][/jitter]. By the time you recover, he is gone.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-INTERSECTION_EVENT.pages.SE:
[blue]"You can see the situation, Mr. Tin Man. Surely you would not leave a former colleague to die?"[/blue]

[red]"Hmph. Always a silver tongue. You should have known to be more careful in a place like this."[/red]

He presses two potions into your hands, and you go your separate ways.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME_EVENT.title: A False Firmament
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME_EVENT.pages.INIT:
At last, you have reached the upper reaches of the Spire. Overhead, countless faintly glowing [rainbow]strange minerals[/rainbow] stud the ceiling. Arranged according to some precise mathematical pattern, they masquerade as a brilliant starry sky in the endless dark.

You stop. This false firmament brings to mind an old acquaintance, a mad pioneer, and the vessel that broke through the barrier enclosing Terra.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME_EVENT.pages.REME: [blue]"May your soul find rest among the true stars."[/blue]
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME_EVENT.pages.ANAL: You commit the motions of these counterfeit stars to memory. They confirm some of your earlier suspicions.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FALSE_DOME_EVENT.pages.CHAS: The past is hardly worth mentioning. The present, too, leads to the future.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WATER_LIKE_SHAPE_EVENT.page:
Clear water suddenly wells up through the cracks between the flagstones at your feet. It swirls before you, gathering into an all too familiar figure.

[fly_in][green]"What a surprise. Even in this wretched tower, I can still smell those revolting feathers."[/green][/fly_in] You turn toward the voice. It is [green]Muelsyse[/green].

[blue]"Still holding a grudge, my lovely elf?"[/blue] Before you can finish, a [blue]jet of water[/blue] [jitter]surges toward you[/jitter]. You raise your staff and deflect it.

[green]"No one here would see it anyway. I might as well drown you, then find a broken robot to stuff you into."[/green]
Enter a [red]difficult combat[/red]. Rewards: [gold]60 Gold[/gold], [blue]1[/blue] [green]Potion[/green], and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rare Relic[/gold].
[red]Lose {TradeCard}[/red]. Obtain the Relic: [gold]Pure Water Elf's Assistance[/gold].
Make an Excuse and Slip Away

You sigh, draw a particularly precious document from your files, and offer it to her. [blue]"Do calm down. A valuable trade in exchange for a little 'assistance' from you. How does that sound?"[/blue]

Muelsyse studies the document for a moment, then snatches it from your hand. [green]"...Fine. This is mine now."[/green] She turns away, her tone softening a little. [green]"Let me be clear: for the sake of this gift, I am sparing you just this once, feathered serpent."[/green]

[blue]"Oh, speaking of robots,"[/blue] you say, pointing to the rubble behind her, [blue]"isn't that a [/blue][rainbow][fly_in][thinky_dots]broken robot[/thinky_dots][/fly_in][/rainbow][blue] lying over there?"[/blue]

[green]"What? Where?"[/green]

The instant the elf turns to look, you leap lightly onto the high wall. Naturally, as a competent agent, you remember to 'borrow' a little something from her before you leave.

[sine][blue]"I told you. I do not like getting my feathers wet."[/blue][/sine]

You step over the unconscious water elf, straighten your belongings, and press on.
